Evidence refinement for member item 5's `enable_pr_auto_merge` row, measured live this shift (2026-08-13 ~14:29–14:30Z, two attempts): passing an **explicit** `mergeMethod: "SQUASH"` on this repo still echoes `(method: MERGE, …)` — the parameter is coerced/overridden, most plausibly by the merge queue governing `main` (whose landed history is one commit per PR regardless). The row's wording should therefore anchor on the failure signal, not the method name: an **empty** `method:` in the echo is the silent-no-op signal; a non-empty echo (even `MERGE`) has landed PRs on this repo through the queue. Keep the "always pass an explicit mergeMethod" instruction, but do not assert the echo will read back `SQUASH` — the implementing dev should fold this into the same row.

The step is justified by the measured incident alone (it is what caught the wrongly-closed card), independent of what the mechanism investigation concludes. The investigation card itself stays scoped to the timeline-mechanism read + the `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` contradiction guard, on `opus`.

**Scope amendment (member item 7 added)** — from the Part-of/auto-close investigation's ACCEPT: the **author-side keyword-hygiene rule**, one deliverable in `references/review-checklist.md`'s PR-shape section (beside the existing `Fixes`-vs-`Part of` first-line rule): GitHub's closing-keyword parser binds `close/fix/resolve` (+inflections, but NOT gerunds) to a `#N` on the same line and ignores all surrounding prose — negations, modals, and warnings included; the sentence written to *prevent* an auto-close is exactly what performed one. Therefore: ⛔ never put a closing keyword next to another open card's number in a PR body; write "card N is not addressed here" / "out of scope: card N", or put the keyword in backticks (measured: code spans do not fire). Reviewers check the PR body for this shape before ready-flip on any `Part of` PR; a report-only detector for the contradiction also patrols it.

Evidence and phrasing source: the mechanism record now in `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`'s header (four live readings) — the implementing dev should keep the reference row self-contained per the id-lint rule.
